info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Wholesale Trading Capabilities API
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Capabilities API empowers financial institutions to initiate and manage trading activities within capital markets. This API provides functionalities for executing trades, managing orders, and accessing market data. Typically utilized by traders and financial analysts, it streamlines operations within the trading department, allowing for more efficient transaction handling and better market insights. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their trading strategies and improve overall market responsiveness.

post.summary: Create a new entry in capital markets for wholesale trading.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new record in the capital markets segment of wholesale trading. It accepts a request body with the necessary details for the capital market entry, which will be processed and stored accordingly.
